notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.21.0.146 Beta - Multiplayer!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32926800/9d21f5d43210e348b54235e032222c7048f5eeb3.jpg

Added:

Added free-for-all and co-op multiplayer game modes
Added two character models
Added many new features to the map including a light house, 2 wharfs, a yacht, a wooden bridge, several new environmental assets and more
Added music
Added resolution and window mode settings


Changed:

Switched to a third person camera system
Modified color grading and post effects
Updated the map and minimap with the new map features
Fixed terrain shader issues
Improved all Steam API code (leaderboard, achievements, stats, multiplayer)
Fixed a ton of bugs


Removed:

Removed crouch


Whats Next?
Before release I need to create a couple of video clips including a gameplay trailer and a cinematic trailer. I would also like to do some final testing before releasing. I expect the game to be ready for release within the next few days!

notes.title: What A Trash Game!
notes.content:
Hello!

"What A Trash Game!" is a game developed for a high school project with the intent to spread awareness about plastic waste in waterways through gamification. The idea is that by littering instead of cleaning, I create a more fun and engaging game that captures the players attention. I can then throw some facts at them about what this littering could do in the real world and the impact it has on wildlife.

Over the next month I will be expanding and improving the game, making it fit for sale on steam. Here is a brief outline of what will change in this time:

    Multiplayer
    Co-op multiplayer
    Steam achievements and leaderboards
    UI and audio improvements
    Performance optimisation
    Bug fixes and stability improvements


Stay tuned for weekly dev updates, follow our socials for #screenshotsaturday, and be ready for the release in early July!
